title: A Tryouts for the Yearbook
premise: Theo Ishikawa has perfected invisibility at Northgate High, until a group chat called 'The Yearbook' begins posting accurate predictions of the future and names him as its next subject. The chat's anonymous members — misfits who call themselves editors of a yearbook that documents things before they happen — reveal they are trying to prevent a tragedy scheduled for championship night. To earn their trust and change the ending, Theo must win the debate championship he's secretly stopped caring about while racing to expose the truth behind the prediction before the final 'audition' claims someone he loves. He wins both arguments in the end: the one on stage, and the one against fate.
about_author: Odile Winterbourne is a former high school forensics coach who swears she once judged a round where a student argued a case that hadn't happened yet. She writes from a small coastal town where the fog rolls in exactly when she says it will.

chapters.title: Head Down, Grades Up
chapters.summary: Theo's POV. We meet Theo mid-debate-round, flawless on stage and silent at home, where his father's expectations rule every conversation. After winning qualifiers without feeling anything, he receives a friend request to a group chat called 'The Yearbook' — its first message predicts tomorrow's fire drill to the minute. Emotional beat: restless curiosity cracking open a carefully sealed life.

chapters.title: The Editors
chapters.summary: Alternating POV between Theo and Priya, the chat's sharp-tongued 'editor-in-chief.' Theo tracks down the other members — four outsiders who've each been named in past predictions — and learns the yearbook has never been wrong. The latest entry forecasts an accident on championship night involving his debate partner. Emotional beat: fear hardening into reluctant belonging as the found family takes shape.

chapters.title: Objection, Sustained
chapters.summary: Theo's POV. The editors try to hack the pattern behind the predictions while Theo, distracted and desperate, nearly throws semifinals — until he realizes winning is his only ticket to staying near the predicted accident site. His father discovers his absences and the argument at home finally detonates. Emotional beat: love against duty, as Theo chooses the team over obedience for the first time.

chapters.title: Final Audition
chapters.summary: Full ensemble POV. Championship night arrives; the prediction says the gym balcony collapses at 8:47 p.m. Theo delivers the final round of his life while the editors execute their plan to clear the balcony, discovering the 'prediction' was engineered by a member testing whether the future can be argued with. The balcony holds; the truth comes out; Theo wins the title and keeps the family. Emotional beat: justice outside the law, and a boy who finally speaks at home.
